en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a large early‑20th‑century public building in a European city. The structure has a steep mansard-like roof with curving gables, tall arched windows adorned with sculpted busts, and heraldic shields on the façade. In front is a small, landscaped park with paths, young trees, gas-style street lamps, and a vertical monument or column with inscriptions. People in period dress walk on the cobbled street, and a horse‑drawn covered wagon passes by. Smaller town buildings are visible in the background.
